title: recruIT
description: recruIT's screening list, notifications and eligibility queries: activity, latency and errors.

panels.title: List instances up
panels.description: Screening list (list module) instances Prometheus can currently scrape.

panels.title: Last successful poll
panels.description: How long ago the query module last finished a poll without any study failing. Works the same whether it runs on its schedule or as one-shot runs pushing their metrics to a Pushgateway - should never be much older than its schedule.

panels.title: Open sessions
panels.description: Browser tabs currently connected to the screening list (connected Blazor Server circuits).

panels.title: New recommendations
panels.description: Patients newly recommended for a trial in the selected time range, as found by the notification detector.

panels.title: Status changes
panels.description: Recruitment status changes saved by users in the selected time range.

panels.title: Emails waiting
panels.description: Notification emails not sent yet - waiting for their digest, or for a retry after failing to send.

panels.title: Page request latency
panels.description: Server-side duration of HTTP requests for the screening list's pages and endpoints, such as the email link. Excludes static files, the long-lived Blazor connection and health/metrics endpoints.

panels.title: UI interaction latency
panels.description: How long the server took to handle a user interaction in the app (a click, a form input) - including any FHIR or database calls it made. The closest measure of how responsive the UI feels.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, by response status code.

panels.title: Open sessions
panels.description: Browser tabs connected to the screening list, and ones that lost their connection, which the server keeps for a few minutes in case they reconnect (Blazor Server circuits).

panels.title: Slowest pages (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration of the five slowest pages or endpoints.

targets.expr: topk(5, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$list_job", http_route!~"/_blazor.*|/metrics|/livez|/readyz", http_route=~"/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Navigations
panels.description: In-app page navigations per second.

panels.title: FHIR request latency: screening list
panels.description: Duration of the screening list's outgoing HTTP requests, by server - mostly the FHIR server, plus the identity provider if sign-in is enabled.

panels.title: FHIR request latency: query module
panels.description: Duration of the query module's requests to the FHIR server: reading studies and writing screening lists.

panels.title: FHIR requests by status
panels.description: Requests per second to the FHIR server, by response status code. Status 0 or empty means the request failed before a response arrived.

panels.title: New recommendations by trial
panels.description: Patients newly recommended for each trial, as found by the notification detector - one notification for every subscriber of the trial.

panels.title: Detector run duration
panels.description: How long one run of the notification detector took, checking every screening list for new patients. It runs every minute.

panels.title: Detector failures
panels.description: Failed detector runs, and screening lists it couldn't check. Both are retried on the next run.

panels.title: Emails sent
panels.description: Notification emails sent, and failed to send. Failed ones are retried every 5 minutes.

panels.title: Email send duration
panels.description: How long handing one notification email to the mail server took.

panels.title: Emails waiting and given up
panels.description: Emails not sent yet (waiting for their digest, or for a retry), and emails given up on after failing to send for 30 days.

panels.title: Poll duration
panels.description: How long the query module took for one poll: evaluating every study's eligibility criteria and writing the screening lists. Shown as the longest poll in each moment's last few minutes.

panels.title: Study evaluation duration
panels.description: How long evaluating each study's criteria and writing its results took, in its latest poll.

panels.title: Candidates by study
panels.description: Patients on each study's screening list after its latest evaluation.

panels.title: Failed study evaluations
panels.description: Studies whose evaluation failed - see the query module's logs for why. Retried on the next poll.

panels.title: Status changes by status
panels.description: Recruitment status changes saved by users, by the status a patient was moved to.

panels.title: Database query latency
panels.description: Duration of the screening list's queries against its PostgreSQL database.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory in use: the screening list's process working set, and the query module's JVM heap.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores in use.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (process_cpu_usage{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$query_job"} * on (instance) group_left system_cpu_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$query_job"})
